item.title: Memorial Bench Honours Much-Loved Street Cleaner
item.description: A new memorial bench has been unveiled in Market Harborough to celebrate the life of a much-loved street cleaner. item.title: Long-Standing Market Harborough Charity Shop to Close
item.description: A long-standing charity shop in Market Harborough is set to close as part of a nationwide shake-up by Cancer Research UK.
